summary: Concrete laborer with over a decade of construction experience in site preparation, concrete placement, and finishing on commercial and residential projects. Skilled in mixing, pouring, spreading, smoothing and patching concrete, installing rebar and expansion joints, and demolishing old concrete surfaces. Operates forklifts, cranes and jackhammers and works from blueprints and project documentation to schedule tasks. Brings a strong safety record, coordinates with subcontractors on completion timelines, and supports team productivity on construction sites.
